top_signals.title: Why the US Is Stepping In to Prop Up Japan’s Yen
top_signals.summary:
The Japanese yen is so weak that even the US has stepped in to prop up the currency. 

The joint US-Japan action, the first in 15 years, underscores their unprecedented determination to defend the Asian currency. Mia Glass explains why. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Chinese Government Bond Futures Kick Off Trading in Hong Kong
top_signals.summary: A new set of Chinese government bond futures completed their debut in Hong Kong, in a relatively steady start to authorities’ third attempt to use the hedging tool to further open up the country’s debt market.
